caption: The drawing depicts three views of a single object, which appears to be a tool or utensil with a bulbous, rounded metallic end and an elongated wooden handle. The object is displayed from the front, side, and back perspectives. The metallic part is colored in shades of gray, representing a shiny surface, and forms a semi-spherical or hemispherical bowl at one end of the handle. The wooden handle is depicted in light brown with visible wood grain texture, smoothly transitioning into the metallic part. Beneath the main illustration, there is a small, labeled scale drawing and a simple line diagram of the same object, including some notations. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the entire composition is contained within a lightly sketched rectangular border.
title: Pewter Ladle
